description.value: The Williams Lake branch of the Cariboo Regional District Library is one of three main branches in a 15-branch regional system serving the Cariboo and Chilcotin. It offers on-site tech services, community programmes, and room bookings. A practical stop for touring cyclists passing through Williams Lake on Highway 97 or the Gold Rush Trail corridor.

The website at cln.ca confirms Williams Lake as one of three main branches with services including programmes, room bookings, and tech services.
